# `smelt.inspect`

<!-- Auto-generated by `cargo xtask gen-lua-docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Availability:** Terminal UI only; raises in headless mode.

**Advanced:** Low-level building block for plugins that need full control. It may change more freely than the rest of the API.

Local session introspection web UI. `smelt.inspect.url()` reads the running server URL; the optional `inspect` plugin adds `smelt.inspect.start()`, `smelt.inspect.stop()`, and `smelt.inspect.open()`.

## `smelt.inspect.url`

```lua
fun(): any
```

Return the URL of the running inspector server, or nil if it is not running.
